string.text: Stalker. Wait, don't shoot! I'm not a zombie!
Stalker. Wait, don't shoot!
What the hell?! Who the hell are you? Are you alive?
Alive. Heh. I don't know what to say to you. I'm alive, but I'm not.
What happened to you?

All I remember is a bright flash. It was about two, maybe three months ago. Maybe more. I woke up at the Doctor's, the one in the swamp. I was with him for about two weeks. He said I was hit by a massive blowout and miraculously escaped. Now I'm hiding out here. There's not a lot of people here, and there's no one here but dogs. There was a kind man in town. He was a journalist. I've seen him a couple times. He was looking for something. He had some documents with him.
Tell me more about him.

Listen, I've been here a week and I haven't eaten anything but rats. If you bring me some human food, say two loaves of bread, I'll tell you everything I know. I'd go myself, but the freedom fighters don't like me much. You understand?
Alright.
Bye.

Oh, man, here's the story. I've heard a lot about the boiler room. like a famous stalker died there. Local legend, so to speak. There's an omen about this place: whoever goes into this place, they'll be haunted by bad luck. So. I decided to visit the catacombs. I went in. I look up, and there's an entrance under the ground somewhere. So I thought, let me see what's in there. Man, you don't know how happy I am to see you. I ain't been out here for half a day. So I come down. I see there's a shitload of hallways and rooms. and rooms. I go into one. I go into the second one. I went into a third. My curiosity was piqued, wondering what this place was. I didn't know these catacombs were so complicated. Eventually, I got lost. Hey, man, listen, I need you to get me out of here. Or at least point me in the right direction. I'll never forget!

I'll give you directions, sure. Look, you go that way, and from there you turn left. Go through the corridor, don't look in the rooms. There's nothing to do. You go down the hallway, and then you go up the stairs. it's on the right. That's your exit.
Hey, man, thanks. I'm gonna owe you for the rest of my life. Never I'll go down in these goddamn catacombs again. Fuck 'em
Hey, you seen any live stalkers around here?
Nah, man. No matter how many times I've been down here, I ain't seen nothing. Rats and skeletons. Nothing else interesting. It's a shame. Man, thanks again. I'm outta here.
You paged me?
Oh, he's here. Good job delivering the box. Appreciate it. So I talked to the Barkeep, and he needs time to figure out what's going on. you know, I guess. I got a case.
What's the case?

Well, there was this new guy I know about a week ago. He's not a rookie, but that's not the point. said, "Vovan, I'm going to the Lake Yantar." It was clear that he was dead... he disappeared on the way to the research institute. I never heard from him again, but one of my couriers said he'd seen him periodically under the bridge at night.
What's that got to do with me?

Because I got a report online that he's gone. I got a gut feeling something ain't right. I don't know what the hell happened to him. Maybe it's a glitch or-- well, you're the man of the hour, you go and see what's going on with him. He only shows up under the bridge at night. The point is, the locals know he's missing, and they're afraid to go there. I don't want that kind of damage.
So what am I supposed to do?
I don't know, I already told you, I don't want him here. Get rid of him. Any way you can. If you do, you can count on me to treat you well. And the loot, of course.
Alright.

Only you'll have to get in touch with the Jackal - he knows where the stash left over from the Jolly Fox. an inheritance of sorts. You haven't forgotten that the bridge is now guarded by a sniper, have you? So you have to go through the tunnel to the left of the bridge. As the railroad embankment crossed, so contact and go out, but not for long, or dark stalkers will detect and then bye bye... Get in touch through your PDA contacts, and don't show your face there at all.
Why are you being so coy? Is there some kind of trick to it? Well, the hell with the catch, you're offering good money.

Alright, you want to go ahead, I'll give you the bare minimum and you can go on your way. But you need money in the zone, too. Maybe I can be of some use to you with my feeble strength. There's a stash behind the railroad tracks. If you get the goods from there, I'll take care of it. And then we can go further afield if you're so eager. But you'll bring it, I'm sure you're an honest man. And I'll pay you for it... 500 rubles. Hmm?

About the Monolith? There's a lot of rumors about this thing, about the Monolith. All kinds of rumors. Some stalker told me that Monolith is some kind of-- What did he say? The basis of all human aspirations and desires? Something unique that to which man aspires. Quin-tez-sen-tsi-ya.

I'm going on, don't interrupt me. He said a lot of clever things back then. I can't remember them all. I didn't really listen to him. I just wished he'd shut up and get the fuck out of the basement. He was right about something. Everyone wants to go to the Monolith. Rumor has it, it's something extraterrestrial.
I heard it landed next to the Sarcophagus, or it punched through the roof of the Sarcophagus and into the fourth reactor, yeah. That's why a lot of people think he's the reason the Zone was created.
Ask around, they'll tell you more than I will.

I have orders for artifacts from the Mainland, so to speak. They're the main currency here. Sometimes I need something for scientists, or religious people. it doesn't matter. You give me artifacts, I give you rubles. On special occasions, I can give you a gift.

Huh, on earth, listen to me. Have you seen all the beasts roaming the neighborhood? You don't think they're any good, except to rip your suit off? No. Oddly enough, if one of these things gets caught in an anomaly, there's a good chance an artifact could be born. It's a miracle, isn't it? The local newbies don't know about it, so they're just sitting here guarding me, heh.

You got it. Alright, let's get down to business. I need a weak gravity gun, and a medium gravity gun, I mean a regular gravity gun. Maybe you've seen one of these before. If you bring them in, I'll take them at a higher price. And if you get both, I'll give you another one of my own. Don't say no, you're always in need of money around here. Especially from me, huh.

Phew, thanks a lot, man. Thought you weren't coming back. One of the patrols spotted something near the bridge. They thought it was an artifact or something, but it was the size of an average person and it was glowing. It was like a phantom or something. We decided to get closer, and the object started to get farther away, so we didn't realize how we got here. We're gonna pack up and head back to our place.

Hey, stalker! Stop! Help us out, we're stuck here. Do you have a surge protector? Can you deactivate these fucking anomalies to get us out of here? It's going to take more than one discharger. We can't clear it with one. We've been trying to send an SOS signal for an hour, but the anomalies must be jamming the signal. Talk to me on your PDA, I'll tell you what you need to do!

Careful in this place, there's a lot of anomalous activity. A step sideways and you're dead. Don't forget the bolts. By the way, I'm picking up a strange signal near the railroad tunnel. It's like SOS, but it's distorted or something. Why don't you go check it out?
Package from the Stalker Bar.
It's a closed container, pretty heavy. It says on the side, "To Toad, from Rat." #138.
Looks like the bandits gave him a bath. In the well. Here's your box, you heavy devil.
You know, they're humorless dudes after all. That stalker smelled so bad, they had to chase the flies out of the bunker. Yeah. Alright, give him to me, and here's for your work.
I was at your locomotive.
Well? What happened?
There was a mutant on the train. I calmed him down, so I don't think we'll have any trouble getting through.
Yeah. That's it? You didn't see any artifacts? Alright, alright. It's a no-no. Here's the suit, I hope it holds up to the radiation.
There was a weird artifact and a mutant. I calmed him down, but here's the artifact, take it.

Wow, you killed the monster, that's fine. Good for you. But this thing is interesting. Very interesting. Give it to me. Okay. I'll tell you something about this artifact. It's rumored to be able to fly with great force at a nearby stalker or monster. yeah, yeah, you heard me. In theory, even kill... Very mysterious stuff, you know?
I've got a science suit for a trip to the research institute, but it doesn't seem very hermetic. Can you do anything with it?
Yeah, I've got some tools here. I'm not much of a repairman, but at the bar, yeah, I'm more of a fixer, but whatever. So what do you got? Yeah.\n\nIt's gonna cost a lot:
Alright, we'll fix it.
Shit, I don't have enough money. I'll come back later.
Here, I think it's alright with him now.
Here you go, everything you need is done.
Well, that's good. I think we're good.
Alright.
Are we there yet?
We're here. Okay, uh. check your gear again.
Alright, shall we move on?
There's a gate on the left, go through it, I'll follow you. I'm just going to change. Go on. I'll catch up with you, don't worry.
I'll catch up with you, don't worry.
You ready to go?

Yeah, we can go. You've been to the dump before, right? You probably know the way, but it's best to stick together. So, you got your outfit on you? If you do, we can get out of here. The trader's counting on us for this, so let's not get too heroic... Though we should pick up some loot if we can.
I think we're good to go.

Alright. You follow me, I've been there a few times, I know the way. Get behind me and cover me if you can. It's usually quiet here, but sometimes the worst of it can come from the middle of nowhere. Alright, gear's in place, let's move.
Let's go. [fast travel]
Let's go.
You got a science suit that's good enough to go to the research institute?
Yeah, I got one. A stalker by the railroad tracks found it. It's beat up, but he spent a couple nights working on it, and now it's good as new.
What do you want for it?

There's a train that's been lying under a railroad embankment for about 30 years. A passing stalker detected a strange pulsation nearby. The assignment is to go check it out, and if it's an artifact, bring it to him. If you do, you get the suit... It's a nice, safe path, which is good for me. More visitors from the north. But there's a lot of anomalous activity. So I said go to the train wreck and see what happens there.
I don't feel like going on a raid with my partner. I'm more of a do-it-yourself kind of guy.
I don't know. You'll be sorry you didn't have someone to watch your back. You sure?
Yeah, I can handle it.
Look, if you get into any shit, I won't send people to you for help.
Ready for your beast in the village. Looks like he's dead.
Strange things are happening. first the controller, now some other shit has come to the village, I'm told. I don't know what's wrong with the zone, but I don't even remember it.
I thought you promised me an outfit.
Yeah, yeah, here you go. And go back to the Research Institute, how much longer are you gonna be here?
My partner needs a stalker outfit for a raid. Can you do something about that?
Wow, I've got a couple pieces, but I don't think you can afford them, though.
Let's get to the point.

There's a creature in a village just to the left of the bridge. Rare, but extremely bloodthirsty. Those stalkers who were there said that human guts were hanging on the branches, as if it was tearing up its victims. No one's ever seen what kind of creature it is. Anyway, heh, I see you're a brave guy, dashing, running back and forth all the time... yeah. So you kill the bastard, and the suit's yours. That's it.
I'll take a look. But no promises.
About my trip to the research institute.
Well? Is there a problem or something?
No, nothing. Forget it.
Go on then.
Hey! Are you okay? Are you awake? Can you talk? Or should I tell the guys to take you back to where they found you?
Hi. What are you doing here?

Stalker, help me. I was walking around the Cordon, and, uh. I met two guys from the Garbage. Bandits, veterans. You can tell they're old school. I had an AK, just a regular 7.62. They just took it away from me. Good thing they didn't kill me, they just shot me in the leg, so I ran away.
So what can I do for you?

I followed them for a while, they went behind the factory. Listen. I've seen you walking around, why don't you give them a warm welcome? I just need a machine gun, that's all. I don't know if they still got one. Well, get me a AKMS. I won't be in debt. If you play around with it long enough to shoot it, when you take it away from them, I'll think you screwed me. Keep that in mind. Just don't forget you're gonna have to give it back, okay?
Hey, stalker. Got a question for you.
Hey, thanks for the gun again, by the way. What do you want?
I'm going on a raid on the Agroprom Research Institute, you ever heard of it? I'm looking for a good partner to back me up if I need to, you know. What do you say?

NRI, huh? Hmm, why not? But you see, my equipment's not very good. To go to the research institute, you need a stalker outfit at least. I've heard the radiation there is pretty bad. So let's do it this way. You get me a stalker suit, and then we'll go right away.
About your rifle.
What about it?
Yeah. Here you go.
Thanks a lot, buddy. I'm going to the village. You come by sometime. Maybe we can work something out together. I'm thinking of going to the dump soon.
I got an outfit for you.
Oh, that's great. I'll just change at the Garbage. We can move right now.
You know how to handle a gun, right?
Huh, you ask me that? I've done things to scumbags you wouldn't even dream of. So... don't forget your overalls, and we'll move right away.
Listen... do you want to raid the Agroprom Research Institute?
What? A raid? With you? So you can put another bullet in me?
Yeah.
Get outta here before I give you a bullet.
You know what? I think I'm gonna keep it.
Yeah, you asked for help. Well, go on, go on. I'll see you around.
I haven't found it yet.
There's a bunch of bastards behind the factory. Give them a good kicking, huh?
This is our place. What are you doing here?
Uh, business. I have an assignment, some papers.

Papers? Hmm. We don't need them. But we do have something. Shotgun. It's right here, right next to it. It's our work. You can have it, but only if you help us. Some stalker wandered into our lab here, right where we want to build our new sanctuary. But there's a warehouse of big crates we can't move. Take this, it'll help with the heavy lifting. Remove the rubble and chase him away. Come back afterward, we'll talk.
So what exactly do you want from me?
Clear the rubble and chase the stalker away. The mark is now showing up on your computer.
Well, I think we're all set.
Yeah, we're good now. Well, we'll keep our word. Apparently. you can be trusted. And trust me with something.
The stalker said he came here through the Agroprom Research Institute. He--
Here, take it. Now leave us alone. Wait, here's something else. This pendant is of great value to us. Keep it safe, and you'll always have good luck. Now leave us.
Hello. How's it going?

Messer, phew! Yeah, I'm fine! I made it to the bar pretty good. Told people you're a good guy. Oh, by the way, I saw some dudes in weird outfits coming out of the lab, but they didn't seem to notice me. Yeah, and I saw some thug at the entrance. I had to give him one artifact to get out of the lab, you know? Those thugs are fucking crazy!
Okay, you're welcome. The three guys in blue gear seem interesting.
Thank you. Trust me, an honest stalker's reputation is worth more than his loot.
Hey. I'm here to see you.

What the hell? Stalker! Shit! I thought I was done for. I found the entrance to a tunnel at the Agroprom Research Institute. I walked for a long time, maybe a day or two, I don't remember. And somehow I came across a door. I thought I was saved, but it was nothing. I climbed in, the door closed from where I came, as if on purpose! And this room was sealed by random clutter. Where the hell are we?

It doesn't matter. What matters is you need to get out of here as soon as possible if you want to live. The way out of the lab is upstairs. I've cleared the way up, the rubble's cleared, you're good to go.
Yes... I'll never forget it, buddy. Thank you. I'm gonna head to the bar now. You get there if you need me. I'll tell everyone you helped me out.
Fuck you!
Hey...
What, you're still here? What are you standing there for?
Where's my box? Hurry up!
Phew... I think I got it!
Messer! What the fuck!
What's going on?
Holy shit! You're gonna get me in serious trouble! I told you to be quiet! So you're gonna make up for it! And don't talk back, there's no way out!
It's just something that happened, you know.
Shit. Looks like we're gonna have to shut this place down.
What do you want?
Yes! That's it! Thank you, stalker. I'll finally be able to raid the research institute.

Listen, this eye was made for me by a stalker, one of the first in the Zone. He's still alive and living in the Swamp. I vaguely remember his house, but I know I was there. He helps everybody, and everybody calls him the Swamp Doctor. He literally picks up stalkers and mutants in pieces. I mean, it's more like a legend. But I've been there. Take this file. I just don't have anything else to give you. The first time I was at the research institute, I went into a bunker, and there was some kind of lab in the bunker. There was a bunch of junk, like safes or something, and that's where I found her. It's some kind of documentation, maybe it'll come in handy. I mean, information's the most valuable thing in the zone.
No problem. I'm off.
Interesting. What do you want me to do?

We need to take it away from him. I tried that myself when he was here. He says I'm not offering enough money, he's asking for more. I'd make some money, and there's artifacts here at the Garbage, but-- Look, why don't you go see him? He's hanging out at the Duty checkpoint north of the Garbage. Put some pressure on him, I think he'll be more cooperative with you.
Can you tell me where I can find some artifacts?
Do you need house keys and bank account numbers?
That'd be nice.

You got a point? Go ahead, go ahead, go ahead. There aren't enough artifacts these days, not enough! I remember a month ago, when there was almost no one here, there were artifacts everywhere. And now there's a flood of greenbacks. And it's even cheaper!
And if you think about it?
Well, I've noticed a strange thing. They show up in secluded places where there are no people. Look in nooks and crannies, houses, basements, construction sites.
Thank you.
Why so shocked?
Ah? Uh, nothing. nothing.
Come on, say it.
No, it's okay.
There's a story. I was talking to a guy, and he said: How can you not notice Elektra?
So? Really, how can you not notice?

So. We talked, I stayed where I was, and he went and hid behind a pile of garbage. A few seconds later I hear the sound of a discharge, I run up there, and there's only a charred corpse, and Elektra next to it.
How did that happen?
So that's what I'm getting at... The zone can do things like this sometimes, so don't be rude to it. After all, she can hear you, believe me.
Then I take it back, if it ain't too late.
It's just bad luck, that's all.
What are you doing?
Do you even care?
I'm trying to make a living, like most people around here. What else can I do, look at nature, pick mushrooms?
Why, boil them and they'll be fine, I guess.
Yeah, and then suffer from ulcers. No.
Well, I'll be off then.
You're a little rowdy, aren't you?
Back off, stalker!
Alright, I'm leaving.
I want to do it the hard way!
That's it, I'm sick of you! I'm gonna roll you on the ground!
I'm leaving, cool it!
Try it!
Why don't you tell me a story?
You've come to the right place. Have you ever seen a ghost?
No.
Yes.
Wh-wh-what?
I'm kidding, I haven't.

You're kidding me! I did! I was walking along a forest belt, and I saw an abandoned house, so I went there for the night. I went inside, checked everything was clean. I just wanted to start the meal, then I hear the door open! My heart went instantly to the heels, I grabbed the barrel and pointed it at the doorway. I feel the cold smell so disgusting that it makes me shiver. And then a transparent figure of an old man emerges from the other room. It stomped around and flew away. Naturally, I didn't need such a night's lodging, so I grabbed my things and rushed away. Now I don't go to such shacks at all...

I've seen it! I was walking along a forest belt, and I saw an abandoned house, so I went there for the night. I went inside, checked everything was clean. I just wanted to start the meal, then I hear the door open! My heart went instantly to the heels, I grabbed the barrel and pointed it at the doorway. I feel the cold smell so disgusting that it makes me shiver. Herak, a transparent figure of an old man emerges from the other room. It stomped around and flew away. Naturally, I didn't want to spend the night, so I grabbed my things and ran away. Now I don't go to such shacks at all...
Wow! I wonder what kind of power this is.
You're lying, storyteller!
Why are you so lethargic?
Do you have a pill? My head hurts.
Yes, there should be. Here you go.
I've got some, but I won't give it to you, you're in short supply.
Stingy... But nothing, the Zone will remember everything!

Thanks, stalker! No, just think about it! We were going on a raid with a friend, and we got hit right in our hideout. My friend got hit in the head, but he was lucky not to pass out, so he pretended to pass out, and I didn't have to pretend. They cleaned it all out, assholes! Now I don't know what to do. I spent the last hundred on food yesterday.
Keep another hundred and you'll figure out how to make money.
Yeah, it's sad. Well, hang in there. Have a good haul, stalker.
Wow, thanks a lot. Man, you're awesome! Klondike and good luck, stalker!
Sorry, I got nothing.
Oh, man. That sucks! Well, there's no judgment!
Hello.
Hello! What are we drinking to?
Were we gonna drink?
Uh-uh-uh... no. Well, don't be shy, it's my treat! So what are we drinking to?
We're drinking to success. in our stalking endeavors.
You said it well, let's have a drink!
That's good! And look, do you know anything about bandits? Because one stalker told me about some dark ones, so I didn't believe him, and to check, you know, I don't feel like it...
Well, you found someone to ask. You think I wanted to check, don't you?
No, I know what you mean. A guy I know told me they're assholes and they ain't even human. They're in the Garbage, so watch your step.
Okay, we'll figure it out. Thanks for the vodka, but I have to get going. Good luck.
Why are you so happy?
I had a big fortune with the artifacts, stalker. Interesting?
Well, in a way, yeah.
And it wasn't a Klondike, it was an anomaly.
What, what anomaly? Tell me more about that.

It's just a gravity anomaly, like, I didn't check it out, you know. Anyway, I found it in the Garbage, near the road to the bar. I was walking along, and then I saw a pile of artifacts lying there, all glowing like a Christmas tree. So I collected them neatly and gave them to the Barkeep. A couple of hours later I decided to go check, and there are more artifacts! So I bought myself a normal suit. It's not comfortable to walk around the Zone in a tattered jacket.
You're lying to me.
I bet there's one in there.
Alright, let's see.
Why are you so wrinkled?
Shit. Stalker, go away. My head's already splitting.
Alright, I'll leave you alone.
But wait. Imagine, I was walking calmly through the Dark Valley, and then my eyes suddenly went black! When I woke up, I saw that I was already in a bar... what the hell is this, do you know?
Maybe I do, maybe I don't. I heard somewhere about controllers, that's what they can do. I can't think of anything else.
About the co-- co-what?
Controllers.
I'll have to ask the guys what kind of bastard they are.
Vodka won't help you, I guess. Well, that's up to you to decide. Come on.
What interesting stories?
Stalker, have you heard anything about dwarfs?
I have. Sure I have.

A guy I know came back to me the other day. He says he tried to break into some abandoned lab on a raid with his squad. They got in through the ventilation shafts and almost immediately ran into these creatures.
Why would they want to get into the lab?

Well, I don't know, but that's not the point. They were wandering around, and they came upon a room. They look, and there is a pile of junk lying there, on top of which one of them is sitting, and others are stomping around, muttering.
Creepy. Wait, how did they get out of the lab, did these mutants did not smell them?
Yes, they did! They just kicked back in, they don't remember how they got out!
Interesting.
Why are you lying?
I'm not lying, stalker! Here's a cross for you!
I won't believe it until I see it for myself. So long.
Last mission, you say? Well, I'm listening to you.

Last assignment. Map the anomalous zones in the area from the roadblock to the railroad and beyond. It's a simple building, you've already covered that area, there's only a small farm on the right of the highway, where you met Ferret.
What's next?
There might be a patrol under the bridge, so I wouldn't go there. There's probably a sniper in the tower. You can imagine the risk of a conflict with the military.
So how do you take measurements?
It's simple. Here, take this device. It measures the activity of anomalous fields. So you approach the anomaly, activate the device, wait a while, then get the results. You got it?
Alright.
You get the results, you get your reward. Go.
Kill the controller
Where do controllers come from? We'll find out someday, but first let's get rid of them. There's one in the factory. Can you handle it?
Toad's ordered the controllers killed.
Kill the bloodsucker
There's a bloodsucker near the bridge. It's not afraid of anyone, it attacks everything, it's already torn many stalkers to shreds. Kill him sometime and we're even.
Toad ordered the killing of a rabid bloodsucker.
So, how long you gonna be here?

I don't know yet. I keep thinking about going to the Garbage, because there are warriors roaming around right under my nose. On the other hand, there are a ton of mutants at the Landfill. I heard they are coming from the Dark Valley. The Dolgars, of course, shoot them, but our brother doesn’t really go there - it’s scary! If an animal doesn’t bite you in the ass, you’ll end up in an anomaly.
On Garbage? Good to know.
Who's the Jackal? I was trapped by his message in the catacombs.
The Jackal? What's the matter? Well, there was this guy. Interested in going downtown, big guy. He was ex-military.
He's dead, and there were darkies waiting for me.

Dark stalkers? Already here? Shit, I can't believe they came through the catacombs to get here. You probably haven't heard, but the whole zone is covered by a post-demonic network of structures. No one's really explored them, and no one knows what's going on down there. I'll tell you, it sucks. Maybe they used him as bait to get to you. You didn't have a conversation last time. But why would they want you? Maybe they were interested in you in your previous life, so they're chasing you now. Yeah.
Maybe we'll see each other again.
Is there anything else you can tell me about Bar?

You can't tell from the way they christened the place, can you? Well, I'll explain it for the special ones. Basically, Bar is the area near the Rostok factory, where the houses of the people who once worked there stand. Well, as you can imagine, they're not there now. In the houses is located the establishment itself, where many people can buy what they need, talk and drink. There's also a base for the Duty faction - strict guys.
A drink, you say. That's fine, but I'm going there on business. Is there anything I can find out about who Gunslinger was?
Gunslinger. hmm. He must have been there, who knows, maybe he had a base there. There's a lot of abandoned apartments, and not just apartments. Why don't you poke around, see what you can find?
Alright.
So, did you find out anything about those documents I found?

Yeah, it was a report from a group of military men fleeing the center. The thing is, after the first big explosion that started the whole damn thing, the military decided to launch a large-scale operation behind the power plant, to the north. The operation had over a thousand soldiers and several divisions of equipment. It says that after all this armada approached a certain area with unknown installations, there was a second explosion... The report contains a report that the remnants of this faction have settled all over the Zone. The documents also have a schedule of anomalous fields, this is very valuable information.
Good.
I found some interesting documents. Talked to Toad, he said I should come to you.

So here we are. Wow! This information is very valuable. The information about the military breaking through to the power plant. Leave them with me, I'll show them to my snitch, he'll tell me what I can do with them.
Here.
Toad, I found some documents in that hangar at the Garbage. It says there's a large-scale military operation in the center of the Zone.

What?! No one's seen you?! Do you have them with you? Hell, if the military finds out, you and I could be in trouble. Look, I don't need those documents, but the Barkeep at Stalker's might be interested. Talk to him when you get to the bar!
Alright, alright. I'll talk to him.
I found the artifact.
Great, did you see anything else unusual?
There were some military guys. Apparently, they were looking for something out there.
That's interesting. I heard that the military was making some kind of breakthrough to the center.
Can you elaborate on that?
No, I don't know much about that. But I think they can tell you more about it in Bar.
We'll see. Here's the artifact.
Well done, Messer. Good job.
What the hell's wrong with me? My head is pounding... Where am I? And what do I owe you?

What could you possibly offer me? When we pulled you out of that burning Death Truck, all you had were those rags on your back. Besides, you don't remember shit anyway. You don't know who you are or where you are. \n\nLet me tell you, my boy... you're in the Zone.
Death Truck...? Boy?! I'm not a boy, and I'm definitely not your boy! Cut that shit out.
Damn right, you are! At least until you work your ass off and earn your keep. I'm the one providing the food, the medicine, and the gun... at least for starters.
Fine... whatever you say. What kind of weapons are you actually gonna give me? At least give me something useful...

Not a goddamn thing, I'm broke as a joke! All I got is the clothes on my back and this PDA. As for the Zone... mate, the Zone is the Zone. No point in me trying to explain it. You gotta see that shit for yourself. By the way... does the name Gunslinger mean anything to you?
Gunslinger? ...No. Nothing. Is that supposed to mean something to me?

I see... Sounds like your amnesia is worse than I thought. 

Alright, listen up. First thing I need you to do is head over to the checkpoint nearby. Take this sealed metal box and leave it by the barbed wire fence - the spot's marked on your map. Then grab the other box that's waiting there and bring it back. 

Don't bother the soldiers. They won't miss a chance for some target practice if they spot you... 

You in or what?
Do I have a choice? I'm broke, I don't remember a damn thing, and I'm stuck in the middle of the Zone with nothing but my dick in my hand...!

No, you don't have much of a choice. So... take the box, make the drop at the checkpoint like I said, and bring the other one back. Do it quietly and I'll sort you out with a weapon and some proper gear.
Fine. Give me the box then. Let's get this over with.
That's the spirit! It's right behind you. Hold on - I've got one last question before you go.
Well...? Go on then, spit it out.

So what do I call you? There's been way too many fresh stalkers running around here lately, and I'm not about to keep yelling 'newbie' or 'amnesiac' every time I need you. You got a proper nickname or what?
You can call me whatever you want... Since you can't give me anything better than a knife, just call me Messer.
Here's your box. Nearly got my ass shot off for this thing.

Damn, you actually made it back. You're a survivor, kid. Maybe those old stories about the Death Truck are real - they say anyone who survives it three times is destined to shake up the whole Zone. We'll find out eventually. \n\nYou didn't peek inside the box... right?
Should I have? Hold on - you keep talking about this 'Death Truck'. What the hell is a Death Truck? You’ve mentioned it a couple times now, so quit being mysterious and tell me what it is.

Alright, keep your hair on... This ain't twenty questions! You turned out alright in the end, so I think we'll get along just fine. 

As for the Death Trucks... truth is, nobody really knows the full story. Not even the eggheads over in Yantar. They're those old ZIL trucks that haul people deep into the Zone. Most of the poor bastards inside don't make the trip alive. 

That's why everyone calls them Death Trucks, and it's unbelievable that you supposedly survived three of them, kid...

That sounds... very strange. I don't remember any of that shit, but three Death Trucks? That's insane. Guess I'm just lucky... or cursed. Either way, you got any more work for me? I can't keep walking around like this with nothing but a knife.

More work? Hmm... There's a nice artifact that's been sitting in the watchtower right by the old railroad bridge for a while now. 

The place is absolutely crawling with strong anomalies - most stalkers are too chickenshit to go anywhere near it. 

But you? You seem like you can actually handle yourself. Think you're up for it?

So what do I actually have to do? Head to the railroad bridge, climb that watchtower, snatch the artifact, and bring it back? Sounds straightforward... except for the part where you said the place is crawling with strong anomalies.

Pretty much. Don't forget to use your bolts, you're gonna need them to check for anomalies. 

Oh, and I almost forgot... here's some anti-rads and an old anomaly detector. It's running low on juice, but it should be enough for one trip. Keep it on your belt, it discharges pretty quick. 

Now stop asking questions and get moving. Don't make me regret giving you this job.
I got the artifact. That watchtower was a nightmare like you warned - the whole area was crawling with anomalies. Took some work, but I brought it back in one piece.
Well, I'll be damned. You actually made it back in one piece. Not bad at all. Hand it over then. I want to see this thing with my own two eyes...
Honestly, I'm surprised I made it back in one piece myself... Here's the artifact. That place was worse than I expected.

There it is! Not bad, kid. Not bad at all. Alright, you earned this. Here, take it. Now move aside - Hoplite's back from Agroprom, and he's already drunk. This one loves talking business when he's hammered.
Hey, Toad... you mentioned hooking me up with a real weapon a while back. I've done a couple jobs for you already, and I still haven't seen shit. What's the deal?
A gun? Huh... What, you planning to go hunting some local mutants or something?
No, that's not what I meant. I just think it's pretty foolish to be running around the Zone with nothing but a knife, that's all.
Scared of blind dogs now, are we? Or is it the crows that keep you up at night?

Look, let's cut to the chase. I'm not gonna stand here and listen to you lecture me, alright? I'm serious, Toad. Running around the Zone with just a knife isn't brave, it's fucking stupid. One wrong step and I'm dead. So either give me a real gun like you promised, or stop wasting my time!

Okay, okay. I'm just messing with you... You're not gonna let this go, huh? 

Some drunk stalker came in the other day and left his piece here and never came back for it. Here, take it. 

Digger just got back from the Garbage. He's only been in the Zone for two months, but the kid's doing pretty damn well for himself. Been filling a lot of artifact orders lately. So here's the deal - I'll contact him shortly and tell him to give you a quick shooting lesson. He'll be waiting for you in the underpass under the road.
Alright, finally... Thanks for this, even if it is second-hand. I'll head down to the underpass and see what he can teach me.
Alright, go on then, smartass. Try not to shoot yourself in the foot! And don't take forever - I might have another job for you later.
Hey, you're Digger, right? Toad sent me. He said you might be able to give me a shooting lesson.

Yeah, I'm Digger. You're Messer, right? Alright, listen up. There's a Flesh over by the factory that should make for some fine target practice. We're gonna sneak up on the bastard nice and quiet, then take it out clean. You understand?
Got it. A lone Flesh shouldn't be too hard to handle.
You'd be surprised... A Flesh can put up a real fight when there's more than one. Just follow me, stay quiet, and when we get close to the beast, shoot it. Let's go.
I met up with Digger. Decent guy - he showed me the ropes. There was a lone Flesh hanging around the factory... That gun you gave me came in real handy.

Nicely done, kid. It's not much, but it should help you get a better weapon soon. \n\nA Flesh, you say? Hmm, that's strange. They usually don't come down this far from the center of the Zone. I've heard there are whole herds of them running around in that town up north, but around here... they're pretty rare.
A town? Here in the Zone? Interesting. Do people actually live there, or is it overrun by beasts? I'm not sure why someone would want to actually live in this shithole...

Yeah, some people still live up there. Not what you'd call lively though... they're mostly just scraping by day to day. This is the Zone, kid. Folks come here chasing riches, glory, or whatever the hell they dream of... and a lot of them end up dead. \n\nAnyway, I've got a job for you. You interested or what?
You already know the answer. I'm in. What's the job?

That's the spirit! Here's the deal: There's a military raid going on right now, but their last patrol went missing just a short while ago in the factory district. That's pretty unusual - this kind of thing doesn't normally happen. I'm still picking up a clear signal from one of their PDAs, which means at least one of those poor bastards is still alive out there.
You're serious? You want me to go rescue some soldiers? I thought those guys had orders to attack any stalker they see on sight.

Any chance I get to help those bastards, I take it. The way I see it, if we do them a favor now and then, they might go a little easier on us in the future. Besides, I'm picking up an SOS from their commander right now. Go check it out and see what's happening over there.

Fine, you've convinced me. I'll go see what happened to that patrol. But seriously, can you give me a better gun? You have no idea what's waiting for me out there, and I'd prefer not to face it with this peashooter.

No can do, kid. I already gave you everything I had. Of course I don't know what happened to them - I don't even leave this damn bunker. 

Tell you what, take this grenade and keep it in your suit pocket so you can grab it fast if shit hits the fan. Here's a first aid kit too, just in case. 

And watch your ass out there. There've been some zombies wandering around the plant lately. They're probably being controlled by someone... or something. So be careful.
Hold on a second. Controlling them? What does that even mean? You're telling me someone - or some thing - is controlling those zombies over there?

Maybe. Hell if I know for sure. 

Listen, you help me deal with this military shitshow and I'll make it worth your while. You'll get a much better selection of gear from me afterwards. 

Now quit stalling and get going.
Hey, are you the commander? What the hell's going on here?
Ahh... shit... A stalker? How the hell did you get here...? I... I didn't call for you. Or did I? Everything's so loud in my head... Get out of here before it... before it gets you too...
What do you mean 'it'? Who showed up? What the hell are you talking about, mate?

The Controller! He's here! He's right up the stairs, I know it! We... we have to find the lieutenant… He went up there! He went up to... to... oh shit... oh fuck... he's in my head again... He's whispering... Get out of here, stalker... before he gets in your head too! Before he makes you... makes you...

Their patrol got ambushed by a Controller. That's what the commander told me, anyway. He was the last one alive when I found him - already losing his mind. He kept rambling about voices in his head controlling him. He still looked pretty rough once I killed the damn thing... but I managed to get him back to the checkpoint safely.

Yeah, I got the confirmation over the radio. They made it back alive. 

Thanks, Messer. I appreciate it. 

But a Controller? How the fuck did one of those brain-twisting freaks end up this far south? That's not normal... something feels off about this.

He looked wounded when I found him and went down fast. But that Controller... what the fuck was it doing to my head? A couple times I felt like I couldn't control my own arms when I got near it. \n\nYou said you'd give me information if I did this job. So let's hear it.

The Controller's influence on the brain? Yeah, some say when you get close, you can't even pull the trigger or work the action of your gun. Nasty stuff. 

Anyway... here, take this. Some food and a couple jars of Jelly. Don't eat that shit, heh. Throw the jar and it'll create a new anomaly where it lands. Just don't use it in the village. 

I've got things to do, so go take a walk for a few hours. I'll call you when I'm ready. 

Oh, and before you go - Poopy and Blue just got back from the Garbage. They're hanging around the village right now. If you want, go talk to them. Maybe they know something about this 'Gunslinger' of yours... or they can at least tell you useful shit about the Garbage. You'll be heading there sooner or later anyway.
Alright, I got it. You got any other jobs for me?

Yeah, head over to the bridge. The client, Ferret, is waiting for his delivery and he'll pay on the spot. 

I think he just got back from a raid... or maybe he stole the stuff, who knows. Either way, he'll have the cash. 

Don't run your mouth with him, Messer. Ferret's a clever bastard. If you hesitate or piss him off, he'll throw you right back where we found you... and this time, nobody's gonna save you. 

We give him the ammo, he gives us what we want. Simple. 

Now get moving.
Okay, I'll go meet him. I hope he isn't as unforgiving as you make him out to be...

You'll be fine, kid. He's in the lone abandoned house by the bridge. Just give him the ammo, hold your tongue, and you won't have any problem. 

Ferret only gets nasty when people waste his time or try to screw him over. 

Stop stalling and go.
Toad sent me. Here's the ammo. By the way... who's that military guy? Damn bastard...

That one? He's from the patrol we hit earlier. The bastard must've gotten away somehow. They've been drinking too much stalker blood lately, those bitches... Next time they come into the Zone, we'll show them how to organize a proper punitive operation! \n\nBy the way... is it true what they say? That you're the only survivor of the Death Truck?
That's a lie. I'm not really dead. At least... I don't think I am. People keep telling me I'm the only one who's ever survived the Death Truck. Guess that means most folks figure I should be dead.

That's a good answer. Most people who come back from the Death Trucks either go completely insane or start claiming they're some kind of chosen one. You just sound confused. Interesting. \n\nSo tell me, 'not-really-dead'... what do you actually remember about those trucks? Or is your head still as empty as a fresh grave?

I wish I could tell you. Truth is, I don't remember shit about the trucks... or anything before waking up here. People keep telling me I survived three of them, but it's all blank. Just a big empty hole where my memories should be. So no, I'm not claiming to be chosen or special. I'm just trying to figure out who the hell I am... and why everyone looks at me like I'm a walking ghost.
So you really don't remember anything? Not the trucks, not who you were... nothing. Just a big blank. I see... \n\nThey say you're after Gunslinger, is that true?
Who is 'they'? Is Toad the one spreading rumors around? Is he the one telling people I want Gunslinger dead?

Oh, you know - the world is full of rumors... Half of them are bullshit, the other half are just waiting to get someone killed. \n\nBut still... interesting that this particular rumor is going around about you.

I don't know any Gunslinger... and I don't want to. \n\nPeople keep throwing that name at me like I'm supposed to know who the hell he is. But I don't. Right now I've got bigger things to worry about than some ghost from my missing memories.
Alright, alright... Relax. If you don't know, you don't know. \n\nSorry about that. Just had to check, just in case. You never know what's real and what's bullshit in the Zone these days.
And who exactly is this Gunslinger supposed to be? Why does everyone keep assuming I know him? I don't remember shit about the guy.

He used to hang around here, but it's been a while... 

Let's cut to the chase. I've overstayed my time here as it is. 

Stay put for a moment, would you? I wouldn't have lasted this long in the Zone if I wasn't careful every second - I'm sure you understand what I mean. 

I'll leave you the backpack, and we'll go our separate ways peacefully. It's not worth causing any problems. 

Oh, and tell Toad I said hello.
I got the backpack from Ferret by the bridge. Here it is. \n\nHe also sends his regards... What a strange character that guy is.

Yeah, he's a weird bastard, that Ferret. But like I said - you'd be fine. Ferret's not as bad as people make him out to be... most of the time. \n\nSo tell me... you didn't look in the backpack, did you?
Are you trying to catch me red-handed or something? No, I didn't look inside it. I just delivered the damn thing like you asked.
Huh... that's clever of you. You really didn't look inside the backpack at all? I was sure you'd check what was inside. Most people can't help themselves.
I think there are artifacts in it. There's this faint humming sound emanating from inside the backpack, and the whole thing is surprisingly heavy.
Fine, we'll call them artifacts. Whatever you say. \n\But tell me this instead - have you still not remembered your own damn name? Or who the hell Gunslinger is?

No, I still don't remember a damn thing. I still don't remember my own damn name, and I have no idea who the hell Gunslinger is. It's all blank up here... \n\nFerret has apparently met Gunslinger, though... This is really turning out to be a strange turn of events.
And you still don't remember how you ended up in the Death Truck either? I'm assuming nothing comes to mind about that either, huh?
No. I already told you - I don't remember a damn thing about the Death Truck. Not how I got in it, not what happened, nothing at all. It's all just blank.

Hopefully those memories of yours come back one day and you finally shake off this amnesia. For now, I've got one last job for you. Finish this one properly, and you'll be free to go wherever the hell you want... \n\nUntil I need you again, of course.
Aren't you afraid that I might just leave and never come back? You say I'll be free to go after this job, but something tells me you'll find another reason to keep me around.

Afraid? Of you leaving? 

I'm not afraid at all. You stalkers need me way more than I need you. Without me, where the hell are you gonna get food, ammo, or medicine? Nowhere. 

Hopefully you're not stupid enough to try anything against me... You still owe me for saving your hide, remember that!
Alright... calm down, old man! I was only speaking hypothetically. Tell me - what do you need me to do?

I got a tip that there are some important documents at the Agroprom Research Institute. They might help us push further toward the center of the Zone. \n\nProblem is, it's a dangerous area. Not many people have returned from there since the last big emission.

The center of the Zone? What could possibly be worth going there for? \n\nCordon is already unpleasant, and we're still pretty far from the center. Pushing deeper just feels like asking to get yourself killed.

Heh-heh... The center of the Zone is a legendary place, kid! They say it's packed with artifacts and all sorts of wonders. Everything a man could want. There's even some fairy tale about a Wish-Granting Entity called the Monolith. I don't buy that crap for a second, though. \n\nThere are also stories about the stalker named Gunslinger who actually reached the Center... and then vanished.
Gunslinger was at the center of the Zone? \n\nWait a second... You're telling me the guy everyone keeps talking about actually made it all the way to the Center? And then he just vanished?

Yeah, although I don't really believe that crap. There's some legend about a 'thrice-born' who's gonna change the Zone or whatever... Anyway, let's cut to the chase. 

This is your first serious task. You need to find some documents at the Agroprom Research Institute and bring them back to me. I don't know exactly what they look like, but they should be in an ordinary white case, like the one you brought me before. 

And listen - you probably shouldn't go in there alone. Find yourself a partner in the village. Ask around, see if any of the guys are up for it. There's a big pack of dogs at the dump and it's not peaceful at all. You won't last long in there by yourself. Plenty of 'heroes' have learned that the hard way. 

Oh yeah... and I promised you some basic equipment. Here. Here's a couple cans of concentrate, you might need them.

Okay, I think I can handle it. 

I'll head over to Agroprom, find those documents in the white case, and bring them back. I'll ask around the village and try to find a partner first - I don't plan on going in there alone. 

Thanks for the equipment... and the concentrate. I'll make good use of it.

Now that's a practical approach! Head north to the Garbage. Be careful - lots of thugs hanging around there lately. There are two ways west from the Garbage to the Research Institute: a hole in the fence or the main road further north. Both marked on your map. 

But listen up, the whole area around Agroprom is contaminated with deadly radiation. You'll start glowing like a Christmas tree in under a minute with just your regular gear. You need a proper protective suit in good condition or you'll be cooked alive. Prepare thoroughly - I don't need another corpse on my hands.

Oh, and the sniper has cleared the bridge, so you can pass safely. Now get moving, stalker.
I'm back. I think this is what you were looking for. \n\nTook me a while to find them. Some were hidden pretty well... almost as if someone didn't want them to be found. Anyway, here they are.
Okay. That's them. You look like you've been dragged through hell... \n\nAlright, I need some time to look these over. Come back to my place in an hour or so and we'll figure out what's next.
Okay, but I'm a bit worn out after that trip... and a bit low on cash at the moment.
Well, I can help with one of those problems... \n\nHere's your payment. Now get out of here and let me deal with this paperwork. Come back in an hour.
So, what's up? I'm back after my extremely luxurious one-hour rest... \n\nDid you manage to make any sense of those documents while I was gone?

Yeah, there's good news and bad news... Bad news is, this looks like it's only part one of two. The good news? According to these documents, the second part is right here in Cordon. \n\nThey're supposed to be taken to the Mainland soon. You get the picture?
Gotcha. I'll grab the other documents.

Great. It should be at the military checkpoint. I recommend waiting until night, when most of them are fast asleep. The box itself is in the commander's office. \n\nAnd a big request - do everything quietly. No noise, no shooting, nothing. The last thing I need is them busting my door down. Act discreetly. The soldiers are on patrol, but they're mostly just going through the motions. There hasn't been a proper shift change in a long time.
Understood. I'll go grab them.
And one more thing - only kill soldiers as a last resort. I don't need any extra heat from them, understand?
Here's your box. Man, it was a real pain in the ass getting it, though.

All right! Okay. Uh-huh. It's all starting to make sense now... The military are clearly looking for something in the center... What the fuck do they want?! There's a lot of maps and scientific papers. You might want to show those papers to Barkeep.
Barkeep? Who's that? And where can I find him?

He's a solid guy, always gets shit done. Runs the 'Stalker' bar just past the Garbage. 

Here's the deal: take these papers to him. He'll be able to make more sense of them than I can. Besides, you've already made a good impression around here, so he'll definitely be willing to help. 

You handle yourself pretty well out there - not many can do what you do. That's exactly the kind of person the Barkeep needs.
Messer, you're just in time. Another job is brewing!
Hi.
Tell me about this place.

This is the road into the Zone. In the cellar behind the small village near the army checkpoint, you'll find a trader. I wouldn't recommend going near the checkpoint itself - the soldiers have orders to shoot stalkers on sight. Killing them is also a bad idea... unless it's your only choice. The trader has to pay for every soldier that dies, and he won't be happy about it. \n\nWatch out for the large packs of blind dogs roaming the plains. They're especially dangerous for rookies. Mutants don't come this far often, but it does happen.
This is truly useful information. Thank you.
What lies further up the road to the north? What should I watch out for if I keep going that way?

The Garbage lies further north. It's a dangerous and heavily contaminated place. Vast piles of radioactive waste and scrap have turned entire sections into impassable death traps. The radiation there is no joke - even with good gear, you can get cooked pretty quickly if you're not careful. \n\nOn top of that, the area is crawling with bandits, so expect trouble if you head that way.
What do you know about this place?

You know... it's not exactly a nice place, to put it mildly. Everyone calls this place a safe haven in the Zone, but I've seen some truly fucked up things happen here that would haunt a man for the rest of his days. 

Our boys may be in charge around here, but that's mostly just for show - for people like you and me. 

But when the Zone decides to take back what's hers... nothing and no one can stop it.
I don't understand... what do you mean?

At night, you shouldn't go wandering around the local apartments... \n\nIf you're planning to sleep here, it's much safer to stay at the bar or with us. The Barkeep has some stories about what happens after dark that would make even the toughest stalkers nervous!
I see... I heard it's not very safe around here at night. Is that true?

Yeah... it's true. It's not very safe around here at night. 

The Zone is the Zone, anything can happen. Our territory is one of the safer spots - only the mainland is calmer. 

But even here, strange shit goes down after dark. People whisper all kinds of crazy stories about what they've seen at night.
Stories? What stories?

Stories? Ah, well... I heard that not all the families evacuated after the accident. Some religious fanatics or sectarians stayed behind. Real strange, otherworldly people. 

They were living here even before the first stalkers arrived. Some old-timers claim they actually had contact with them. How they survived for so long is a mystery. Then one day... they just vanished. No one ever saw them again. 

That's why I always say - at night, it's better to stay somewhere crowded. Don't sleep in those old apartments. A lot of them are still locked up, and who knows what's inside.
The Barkeep's Story
Bar patrons and the Barkeep himself recommend spending the night in crowded places, as the local apartments may harbor dangerous secrets.
Why don't you tell me about this place?

This is the road leading into the Zone. I wouldn't recommend going near the checkpoint or letting the soldiers spot you - they have orders to shoot stalkers on sight without warning. \n\nFurther north you'll come across a destroyed bridge that also has a permanent checkpoint. Packs of dogs roam the open fields here, making it quite dangerous for newcomers. Mutants occasionally wander into the area as well.
What's further north, beyond the roadblock?

A place we call the Garbage. It's a gloomy, miserable shithole - not somewhere you'd want to spend much time. The whole area is basically one giant radioactive junkyard full of wrecked cars, old military equipment, and mountains of toxic scrap. In some places the piles are so massive it's impossible to pass without getting cooked by radiation. Bandits have taken over a lot of it too. \n\nIf you're heading north, watch your step and keep your eyes open. The Garbage doesn't forgive mistakes.

There's a house in the village just beyond the bridge. People say it's extremely radioactive. There's definitely something inside - normal thirty-year-old scrap wouldn't put out radiation like that, and it would've been looted a long time ago. \n\nLuckily, I managed to get my hands on a large transport capsule designed for highly radioactive materials. I think it'll be just right for the job.

Waste paper, huh? Well, well... Since your memory is clearly shot, let me explain it to you one more time... 

The real treasure in the Zone isn't guns, artifacts, or loot. It's information. A simple piece of paper can be worth more than all the gold in the world if it contains the right secrets. 

So if you find anything interesting around here, don't sell it to the first guy who offers you cash. Bring it straight to me. I'll pay you well for it. Sure, other traders might want it too, but I can always outbid them!

There's plenty to burn, alright. You got caught right in the middle of that blowout, you fool! It was a psi-wave. n\nThat shit kills everything in its path. Nobody really knows what it is or where it comes from, but most say it originates somewhere deep in the center of the Zone. n\nAnyway... good job figuring out you need to hide when one of those hits - if you're still alive, that is.

I'll let you in on a secret: artifacts often appear after big emissions... And a lot of strange things happen to the creatures around here too. But I suppose you'll see it for yourself soon enough. n\nOh, and one more thing about the artifacts -they say their properties can change over time. Sometimes they even disappear completely. Weird stuff happens to them. Well... Anyway, consider yourself warned.

I'm telling you, it's all gone! What, are you some kind of stalker or what? Go search the village - maybe someone left some food behind. If not, you can always try catching rats or crows... if you're lucky enough to hit one, heh-heh. Or just trade with the guys around here. They usually have something to eat. 

But keep this in mind: almost everything you find out there is probably radioactive. Half the bushes in the Zone are irradiated. Sure, if you look hard enough you might find something cleaner, but I still wouldn't recommend eating random junk you pick up off the ground. 

You think I'm sitting here for the scenery? For miles around, I'm the only place where you can get halfway decent food... usually clean, if you're lucky. 

And to check if something's radioactive, just scan it in your backpack. Make sure you've got a dosimeter on you. If it's contaminated, you'll hear a beep.

Are you kidding me? You really don't know? The radiation levels around the Research Institute are insane - high enough to fry an egg on the ground. I'm not crazy enough to go in there without proper protection. You need something better than a leather jacket, at least a decent stalker suit. That's the bare minimum. 

You might want to check with Toad. I heard someone brought one to him recently.

Oh, and besides the suit, I also need a gravity artifact. It's incredibly useful for raids and expeditions. They do make you hungrier than usual, but that's a small price to pay. If you can't find a normal one, two weaker ones will do just fine.

Messer, you near the tunnel? Do me a favor - if you've got a spare discharger, clear that anomaly inside. One of my couriers from the Bar should be passing through soon, and that's the only route he uses. Do this for me and I'll make it worth your while.

Hmm, no one knows the full story, but there's a dark tale about him. They say he was cursed. Everyone who got close to him ended up dead or missing. His friends started having nightmares - hearing voices, seeing things that shouldn't exist. Then they lost their minds. Some shot themselves. One went completely mad and started smearing the walls of his cottage with blood and shit. The rest just vanished. \n\nThen one day the stalker himself disappeared. He went to sleep in a small room and was gone by morning, leaving all his gear neatly laid out like he was just stepping out for a minute.
I don't have it.
Trapped soldiers

A group of soldiers has fallen into a trap near the end of the railway tunnel. They're surrounded by a dense cluster of anomalies. One of them - probably the commander - is asking for someone to run to Toad. Apparently he thinks Toad can help them.

In exchange for helping me, I want you to bring me a "Dead Head" artifact. Yeah, that's its name. Don't worry, I'm not asking you to go around chopping heads off... though with you, I wouldn't be surprised. 

If you're short on cash, the artifact will do just fine. I need them pretty badly. But if you'd rather pay normally, I've got a set rate for every kill, plus a little extra for my own hard work. 

One more thing: if you're part of a faction, completing this 'atonement' will strip you of your rank and make you neutral again. Don't count on them welcoming you back with open arms after that.
I was hoping you could answer a few questions I have, Toad.

You understand how it is - I sit on my ass here all day, but the real shit happens out there in the Zone. I can give you the general rundown, or I can tell you about the places around here that I've actually walked myself.
Tell me a little about the Zone. I've heard all sorts of stories, but I want to hear it from someone who actually knows.
Go ahead and ask.
What are the military doing in the Zone anyway? I mean, why are they even here? What do they actually want?

They're guarding, that's what they're doing. Whether they're protecting the Zone or protecting the world from it... who the hell knows. 

Expeditions pass through here from time to time. But those Ukrainian soldiers don't respect the Zone, and the Zone sure as hell doesn't respect them back. 

They look down on us stalkers like we're nothing, acting like gods. They won't lift a finger to help you even if you're dying right in front of them, but they'll shoot you dead without hesitation. 

I've managed to find some common ground with a few of them, though. After all, where else are they gonna get their vodka and dirty magazines? Just don't provoke them for no reason - they'll swat you aside without a second thought.
Tell me more about the Zone.

The Zone... It's not just some random stretch of land around the old power plant. It's something much weirder than that. Truth be told, I don't think anyone in the outside world could really explain what it is. The Zone feels like its own separate reality - dangerous, unpredictable, and strangely addictive. \n\nAnd you know why it pulls so many people in? Because here, if you get lucky, even a nobody can strike it rich overnight. The closer you get to the Center, the faster the money finds you.
What is so dangerous about this "separate reality" that you speak of?

Dangerous? Where do I even begin... 

You can die at any moment out here, and not just from a soldier's bullet - though there are plenty of trigger-happy bastards around. Getting shot is actually one of the cleaner ways to go. The anomalies are a whole different nightmare. They can crush you, melt you, or rip you apart in ways you don't want to imagine. Even the mutants steer clear of them. 

Speaking of mutants, they're nasty pieces of work - the real children of the Zone. So don't wander around unarmed if you value your life. 

If you want the full picture of how the Zone kills, ask the other stalkers. They've got stories that would make your skin crawl.
How does one actually get rich here in the Zone?

Well, buddy, that amnesia of yours must really be kicking your ass. Don't you remember? 

Artifacts, kid. That's the real gold in the Zone. People from the Mainland will pay insane amounts for any weird trinket we drag out of here. They're worth more than gold, diamonds, or plutonium combined. 

Why? Because these things have powers you won't find anywhere else in the world. Hang the right one on your belt and bullets might start missing you. Some can heal you, boost your strength, or do all kinds of crazy shit. That's why they're so valuable. 

You can find basic ones right around here, close to home. But if you want the really good stuff - the ones that can make you rich - you have to push deeper toward the center of the Zone.
Does anyone know what goes on in the center of the Zone?

People talk all kinds of shit if you ask them. You'll hear every wild story imaginable... but I don't buy most of that supernatural nonsense! \n\nWhat I do know is that the Center is supposed to be full of incredibly valuable artifacts. The catch is, I haven't met a single person who's actually made it back from there alive.
Do you know what happened to me?

Well, you sure asked the right question, buddy. It's a shady business, you know... 

We found you in what they call a "Death Truck." Those are usually old ZILs that come rolling out from the center of the Zone every now and then, loaded with bodies. No one knows where they're headed. One of them crashed, and you were found amongst the wreckage. That's the crazy part - they've found wrecked Death Trucks before, but never anyone alive inside. 

Sorry, kid. That's all I know. You'll have to figure the rest out for yourself.
So... who's this "Gunslinger" guy?

A well-known stalker... They say he's one of the few who actually reached the center of the Zone and made it back alive. 

Of course, around here there are more legends about heroic stalkers than actual heroes. 

As for me, I've never done business with him. Seems he has his own channels. Ask around the Zone - someone might know more about him.
What kind of stalker is called a ghost?
Oh, that's another legendary man. I haven't heard from him in a while. Probably disappeared somewhere in the depths of the Zone.
What's going on around here?

Ah! Well, this is the antechamber of the Zone. Army cordon. It's relatively quiet, except for the military sometimes having fun, making a mess. Experienced stalkers are rare here, only rookies linger, and who even stay forever, yeah... There's a rookie camp nestled right next door, on a farm. Look, they know how to pull the trigger, too, so don't get cocky. What else? Well, there's no good loot to be found here. There's an abandoned factory across the road. To the north, behind the railroad embankment, is the remains of a village, and to the south is a roadblock. By the way, there are mines planted somewhere, so be careful. There was also a bridge in the center, but it fell down. That's about it.
Tell me more about the blockpost.

There's a few soldiers with orders to shoot without warning, so you'd better stay away from it. If you offend them, they can call in the SWAT team from the outer cordon. They'll make such a mess upstairs that I won't have any clients for a month... I don't know the commander of the soldiers much: he likes to lay low. He's the reason I'm still here.
Tell me more about the bridge.
It's two steps north, you'll see it right away. I don't know for sure, but I've noticed some of the older stalkers sometimes walk along the railroad tracks. Maybe it's a trail.
Can you tell me more about the factory?

When you cross the road, you'll see it right there. It's a brick building. What they could steal from there was stolen long ago, just a box left. It's a favorite place for bandits. I don't know if they're there now, but be careful. You ain't got nothing to be robbed from yet. but what do you want with all this trouble?
Tell me about the village.
You're so tedious! Well, the village is just like a village! The previous inhabitants were dead before the Perestroika.
Thank you, that's all.
There's something else I'd like to know.
Tell me about this place.

Ah! Well, it's the antechamber of the Zone. Army cordon. It's relatively quiet, except for the occasional military raid. Experienced stalkers are rare here, only rookies linger, and some of them stay forever. There's a rookie camp nestled right next door, on a farm. Look, they know how to pull the trigger, too, so don't get cocky. What else? Well, there's no good loot to be found here. There's an abandoned factory across the road. To the north, behind the railroad embankment, is the remains of a farm, and to the south is a roadblock. By the way, there are mines planted by the soldiers, so be careful. There was also a bridge in the center, but it fell down. I think that's about it.
Okay, thanks.
Tell me more about the roadblock.

There's a few soldiers with orders to shoot on sight, so it's best to avoid it. If you offend them, they can call in the SWAT team from the outer cordon. They'll make such a mess upstairs that I won't have any clients for a month... I don't know the commander of the soldiers much: he likes to lay low. He's the reason I'm still here.
Tell me more about the fallen bridge.

It's just two steps north of here, you'll see it right away. There used to be a bridge over the road, and then it fell down during one of the blowouts. The military's got a post there and they don't let anyone in. but if you grease up, they'll let you in. In general, it's better not to shine there, unless you're heavily loaded or wounded.
Can you tell me more about the factory?

When you cross the road, you'll see it right there. It's a brick building. What they could steal from there, they stole long ago, only one box left. It's a favorite place for bandits. I don't know if they're there now, but be careful. You ain't got nothing to be robbed from yet. but what do you want with all this trouble?
Tell me about the farm.
You're so tedious! Well, it's just a farm. The pigs were dead there before the Perestroika.
I'm about the anomaly in the tunnel.
